Privacy Policy

This page describes how VOrigin expects to handle personal information when the website receives contact enquiries.

DRAFT — This text was prepared by VOrigin to complete the website and still requires review and approval before it becomes effective.

Scope

This policy applies to the VOrigin website and the forms, links or contact channels presented on it. It does not automatically apply to third-party websites.

When you contact us, the website may receive your name, email, company, country, website, enquiry type and message.

How we use information

VOrigin uses information to respond to enquiries, assess potential partnerships, maintain website security, troubleshoot errors and retain necessary correspondence records.

VOrigin does not sell personal information or use contact details for unrelated marketing without an appropriate basis.

Service providers

Information may be processed by hosting, anti-bot, email or technical infrastructure providers needed to operate the website. These providers may use information only for the relevant service.

Retention and protection

VOrigin retains information only as long as needed for the purposes above or as required by applicable law. We use reasonable safeguards to limit unauthorized access, loss or misuse, but no internet system can be guaranteed completely secure.

Cookies and analytics

The website prioritizes cookies necessary for basic operation. At the time of drafting, VOrigin does not enable a third-party analytics provider. If this changes, the website will update the relevant information before implementation.

Your rights and contact

Depending on applicable law, you may request access, correction, restriction or deletion of your information, or withdraw a contact enquiry. Contact contact@vorigin.vn; we may need to verify the request to protect data.

Policy changes

VOrigin may update this policy when the website operation changes. The version published here is a draft reference until formally approved.
